{{Current events|year=2022|month=12|day=11|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 North Kosovo crisis]]
**[[Kosovo Serbs|Serb]] protesters in [[Northern Kosovo]] block main roads for a second day following a nighttime exchange of fire with [[Kosovo Police|police]] after the arrest of a Serb former policeman, amid rising tensions between authorities and [[Kosovo]]'s Serb minority. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbs-kosovo-block-roads-clash-with-police-ethnic-tensions-worsen-2022-12-11/ (Reuters)]
**[[Prime Minister of Kosovo|Kosovo's Prime Minister]] [[Albin Kurti]] states that "the barricades from masked criminals in the north must be removed immediately". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/11/tensions-soar-after-attacks-on-police-in-north-kosovo/ (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Serbian President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] calls an emergency meeting of the [[National Security Council (Serbia)|National Security Council]]. After the meeting, Vučić states that "it is important to call on Serbs and Albanians to keep the peace" and that he "made certain decisions and gave orders". [https://www.politika.rs/scc/clanak/528486/kosovo-i-metohija-kurti-aleksandar-vucic-sednica (''Politika'')]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
**Six [[Pakistan]]i [[civilian]]s and a [[Taliban]] fighter are killed during a [[shootout]] between [[Afghan Army|Taliban forces]] and [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldiers]] over a dispute on construction of new [[border checkpoint|checkpoint]]s on the Afghan side of the [[Chaman]] border. Seventeen Pakistani civilians, ten Taliban fighters and three Afghan civilians are also injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/11/unprovoked-firing-from-afghan-forces-kill-civilians-pakistan-chaman (Al Jazeera)]
*[[December 2022 Peruvian protests]]
**Two people are killed and four more are injured as pro-[[Pedro Castillo]] protests in [[Peru]] escalate. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/12/peru-protests-two-dead-and-four-injured-as-election-calls-grow-after-castillo-ousting?utm_term=Autofeed&CMP=twt_b-gdnnews&utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1670818743 (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three children die and another is critically injured after falling through the [[ice]] on the frozen [[Babbs Mill Lake]] during a [[cold wave]] in [[Kingshurst]], [[West Midlands (region)|West Midlands]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-63944005 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[South Sudan]] declares a [[measles]] outbreak with a spokesperson for the Ministry of Health reporting that there are currently 2,471 cases and 31 deaths from measles reported in 22 counties. [https://english.news.cn/20221212/c875f4efa7d44ed3809d7b9ececb7e32/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pan Am Flight 103]]
**Federal authorities in the [[United States]] announce the arrest of a [[Libyans|Libyan]] man [[criminal charge|charged]] in relation with the [[Lockerbie]] bombing in 1988, which killed 270 people. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/11/uk/lockerbie-bombing-suspect-custody-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*Three people are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a bar in [[Rome]], [[Lazio]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-shooting-rome-residents-meeting-2022-12-11/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and four others are injured during a [[car chase]] between the [[Carabinieri]] and another vehicle in [[Alessandria]], [[Piedmont]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2022/12/11/in-fuga-dai-carabinieri-salgono-a-quattro-i-morti-nellincidente-ad-alessandria_edafb169-3731-403e-9380-52a125668d45.html (Ansa)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artemis 1]]
**The uncrewed [[Artemis 1]] mission, the first of the [[NASA]]'s [[Artemis program]], ends with a splashdown of the [[Orion (spacecraft)|Orion]] capsule in the [[Pacific Ocean]] off the coast of [[Baja California]] at 17:40 UTC. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/science/artemis-orion-mission-ends-splashdown-1.6682011 (CBC News)]
